name: com.realityse.ravensight
description: Official Unity SDK for Ravensight player analytics. Sessions, batched events, an offline queue, a saved player opt-out and the server kill switch. The 0.2.1 core was verified in the Unity 6 Editor and a macOS player; the 0.3.0 typed events and health sampling are not yet verified.

samples.description: One file tour of tracking, flushing, feedback, the privacy toggle and reset.
